defective_pattern: Unanchored 4-digit regex mistakenly capturing year in meta-annotation prose without bibliographic syntax validation.
why_defective: Using permissive, unanchored regular expressions to extract years from text can inadvertently match 4-digit numbers in unrelated meta-annotations or prose.
observed_symptoms: Capturing false positive years from prose or meta-annotations.
Corrupted bibliographic entries due to incorrect year extraction.
corrective_remedy: Implement strict bibliographic component verification. Anchor regex patterns to specific bibliographic syntax boundaries (e.g., parentheses for APA) and explicitly exclude meta-annotation sections before parsing.
